Eval runs question sets (--qrels: graded questions) and session episodes
(--episodes) against one or more named configurations of the pg store, in
process (no server, no copy of the binary), and against rg and fd, the
baselines an agent already has. Each run gets a directory with results.jsonl
(one line per set, query and system: ids, ranks, the top files, grades,
times; never a question's text), summary.md and run.json.

eval compare reads two runs and prints them against each other.

Usage:
  agent index eval [flags]
  agent index eval [command]

Examples:
  agent index eval run --config base=base.toml --qrels questions.jsonl
  agent index eval compare RUN_A RUN_B --set questions

Available Commands:
  run         Run question sets and episodes against named configurations and rg
  compare     Compare two eval runs, set by set and system by system
  show        Print an eval run's summary again

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for eval

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent index eval [command] --help" for more information about a command.
